items.title: Tilly Norwood to Lead New Movie 'Misaligned,' Marking Feature Debut for AI 'Actor'
items.excerpt: AI 'actor' Tilly Norwood, who ignited industry-wide anger in late 2025, will front her first feature — 'Misaligned,' a comedy-drama set in the surreal 'Tillyverse.' Creator studio Particle 6 says it has 'retrained and upskilled' 30+ film and TV creatives since launch.
items.why: The synthetic-performer debate crosses its biggest threshold yet: an AI character headlining a feature. Directly reshapes casting, likeness and performance craft questions.
items.notes: THR (1236638719) and Deadline (1236974639) ran the same story 07-06 — de-duped, Variety kept. Distinct from prior Tilly-agency coverage.

items.title: Midjourney Seeks to Reveal Studios' Use of AI in High-Stakes Copyright Battle
items.excerpt: Midjourney is appealing a magistrate judge's order limiting discovery into how Disney, Universal and Warner Bros. themselves use AI in their shows and movies, seeking to put studios' internal AI use on the record as part of its fair-use defense.
items.why: Turns the studios-vs-AI lawsuit inside out: Hollywood's own quiet AI adoption becomes evidence, shaping how openly studios can use generative tools.
items.notes: Carryover (verified 07-06 run; not yet published as a card). Engadget follow-up (2207936) de-duped, Variety original kept.

items.title: 'My Friend the Porn Star' Trailer: Doc Using AI to Anonymize Its Subject Premieres at Karlovy Vary
items.excerpt: Rosa Friedrich's doc-erotic hybrid premieres in KVIFF's Proxima competition July 7. When her subject withdrew before shooting, Friedrich used AI to anonymize his footage, turning the film into a collective experiment on visibility and desire.
items.why: A concrete new documentary craft use for AI — anonymization as an ethical and aesthetic tool — tied to a major festival premiere happening this week.
items.notes: Different KVIFF story from the already-published Karlovy Vary AI cards (07-04~07-06 cluster covered industry days/Foster).

items.title: What You Need to Know About A24's Partnership with Google DeepMind
items.excerpt: A24's $75M research partnership with Google DeepMind — developing AI-powered tools like generated storyboards for filmmakers — has split the indie world: is the studio shaping AI for artists, or legitimizing models trained on unlicensed creative work?
items.why: The defining indie-film AI story of the moment: the tastemaker studio building filmmaker-facing AI tools with DeepMind, and the backlash defining the terms of adoption.
items.notes: Variety's original A24/Google report (1236787297) published 2026-06-22T15:27Z — misses the 336h window by ~7h; this NFS explainer (06-30) is the fresh vehicle. Overlaps Curious Refuge 06-26 video (social pool).

items.title: Hope, AI, and Indie Ambition: The Contradictions That Defined Annecy 2026
items.excerpt: Cartoon Brew's festival wrap frames Annecy 2026 through its contradictions: official programming embraced AI panels and pipeline talk while crowds booed AI-made work, and indie ambition surged in parallel.
items.why: Synthesizes the animation world's split personality on AI right after its biggest festival — richer than single-incident coverage.
items.notes: Carryover (verified 07-06 run). OVERLAP RISK: Annecy takeaways card (Variety) published 2026-06-30 — different outlet/angle; curator should confirm it reads as new.

items.title: Hasbro's TV Contracts Allegedly Ask Child Voice Actors to Sign Rights Away for AI Use
items.excerpt: The UK's Agents of Young Performers Association alleges Hasbro's contracts ask child voice actors to sign away rights for AI capture, cloning and training, warning a parent's approval 'should never be a blanket licence' to reuse a child's voice indefinitely.
items.why: Escalates the AI likeness fight to its most sensitive front — minors' voices — with a named studio and organized pushback.
items.notes: Carryover (verified 07-06 run). Animation Magazine's 6/25 Peppa Pig piece covers the same cluster — de-duped, THR kept.

items.title: 'Apart' Wins Best in Show at SIGGRAPH 2026 Computer Animation Festival
items.excerpt: SIGGRAPH 2026 (July 19-23, LA) named its CAF winners — 'Apart,' 'Beyond Words,' '18 Months' — and unveiled Production Sessions with Weta FX, ILM, Pixar and Google DeepMind, including the artist-centered AI-assisted workflow behind 'Dear Upstairs Neighbors.'
items.why: The premier graphics conference putting AI-assisted animation on its main production stage, tied to award-credible shorts, ahead of its July 19 opening.
items.notes: Carryover (verified 07-06 run). PARTIAL OVERLAP: 'Dear Upstairs Neighbors' workflow card published 2026-07-02 — this story's core (CAF winners + sessions) is distinct. Edge-of-window (06-23).

items.title: Runway Introduces Agent 2.0 — Prompt-to-Finished-Campaign Video Production
items.excerpt: Runway's Agent 2.0 goes from a single prompt to a planned multi-shot sequence with consistency locking, voice/music integration and a rough assembled cut — an 'autonomous production assistant' the user supervises, now extended into campaign creation and performance analysis.
items.why: A major agentic step in the filmmaker-facing video stack from the company behind the AI Film Festival — changes the unit of work from shot generation to supervised production.
items.notes: OFF-LIST EXCEPTION: primary-source announcement; no fresh coverage found on the section's allowed_domains (Kling 3.0/Higgsfield NFS pieces are Jan-Feb). Date from visible post date (no time; midnight UTC assumed — mid-window, gate-safe). Companion launch video on YouTube 06-25 (MWImNn5PkV8) not double-listed.

items.title: Boris FX Acquires iZotope, Maker of RX and Ozone Audio Tools
items.excerpt: Boris FX (Mocha Pro, Continuum, Silhouette) is acquiring iZotope, bringing the ML-driven RX audio-repair and Ozone mastering tools into its VFX/post plugin family — consolidating AI-assisted picture and sound finishing under one roof.
items.why: Post-production toolchain news: AI-assisted audio repair joining the standard VFX plugin stack changes finishing workflows for film editors and post artists.
items.notes: WEAKEST DESIGN-HOOK in pool (acquisition news, though both companies are AI-tool makers used daily in post). RedShark ran the same story — de-duped, postPerspective kept. Curator may drop.

items.title: A Conversation with Ron Howard | Runway AI Festival 2026 (video)
items.excerpt: Runway posts the full Alice Tully Hall fireside with Ron Howard from its 4th AI Film Festival: Howard on AI 'democratizing' filmmaking, why audiences will decide whether AI films succeed, and the new visual aesthetic he expects to emerge.
items.why: An A-list director on the record, at length, about AI filmmaking — the festival happened June 11 but the full conversation only became watchable 06-26.
items.notes: Published time from channel RSS (uploadDate 2026-06-26T19:29:53Z). Variety's event report was 06-12 (stale); the video upload is the fresh artifact.

items.title: Here's How I Built an Anime Using AI (Step-by-Step) (video)
items.excerpt: The AI-filmmaking school walks through a complete anime-style production pipeline built on current gen-video tools — from character design and voice consistency to shot assembly — as a reproducible step-by-step workflow.
items.why: Concrete, replicable AI animation craft from the most-watched AI filmmaking educator — workflow substance rather than model hype.
items.notes: Published time from channel RSS (2026-06-30T17:52:04Z). Chosen over CR's 06-26 A24-partnership video to avoid duplicating the NFS A24 candidate.

items.title: Building An Automated Video Production Factory (video)
items.excerpt: Matt Wolfe chains agentic AI tools into an end-to-end automated video production pipeline — scripting, generation, editing and publishing — demonstrating how far a one-person 'video factory' can currently go.
items.why: Same-day look at agentic automation of the whole video pipeline, matching this cycle's Runway Agent 2.0 theme from the creator-side.
